concept.title: Canceling/returning automatic defogging logic on automatic climate control system

keywords.indexterm: windshield defrosting and defogging canceling/returning automatic defogging logic on automatic climate control system

li.p: Turn the EV button to the POWER ON or DRIVE READY position.
While touching the air conditioning (A/C) icon, touch the air intake control icon at least 5 times within 3 seconds.
The recirculation indicator blinks 3 times in 0.5 second of intervals. It indicates that the defogging logic is canceled or returned to the programmed status.

conbody.p: If the battery has been discharged or disconnected, it resets to the defog logic status.
